error_chain: Babel preset-typescript runs plugin-transform-typescript which strips type annotations but defers decorator emission to plugin-proposal-decorators

plugin-proposal-decorators with legacy=true emits the stage-2 form: decorators run as functions wrapping the class and Reflect.metadata('design:paramtypes', ...) side effects fire, which Nest's IoC depends on
SWC's swc_ecma_transforms_typescript strips type annotations in the same logical step as decorators.rs, but decoratorMetadata defaults to false unless explicitly set in jsc.transform
Without decoratorMetadata, SWC emits the wrapped class without the Reflect.metadata side effects, so Nest's container has no design:paramtypes entry for the constructor and DI resolution fails
trigger_conditions: Customer's swc config sets jsc.parser.decorators=true and jsc.transform.legacyDecorator=true but omits decoratorMetadata=true, so Reflect.metadata calls are never emitted
Babel's plugin-proposal-decorators emits the metadata side effects for free under legacy mode; SWC requires them to be opted in
Nest's IoC silently fails when getMetadata returns undefined, presenting as a runtime undefined-access rather than a clear DI error

expected_answer.error_origin: swc_ecma_transforms_typescript / decorators.rs not emitting Reflect.metadata calls because jsc.transform.decoratorMetadata is false by default
expected_answer.bypass_reason: Babel's plugin-proposal-decorators legacy mode emits the metadata side effects automatically; SWC treats them as an opt-in flag
expected_answer.correct_config: Set jsc.transform.decoratorMetadata=true in .swcrc alongside legacyDecorator=true, or keep Babel for the decorator pass and use SWC only for non-decorator files
